securityInfo.cardAltName: photo of a woman exploring DigitalDSA web app with her dog representing as security check
securityInfo.cardHeading:
Your Messages Stay Private,
Your Deals Stay Sweet!

items.title: Your Data Stays Private –
items.desc: We use ISO 27001-grade security to protect your information. No leaks, no unwanted calls—just secure access.

items.title: No Fishy Requests –
items.desc: We never ask for OTPs, PINs, or passwords. If someone does, they are not from DigitalDSA.

items.title: Safe Loan Applications –
items.desc: Your documents are encrypted and stored securely, following ISO 27001 and DPDP Act compliance.

items.title: Beware of Fake Agents –
items.desc: DigitalDSA never asks for payments outside our platform. We follow RBI’s digital lending guidelines to ensure secure transactions.

items.title: Honest Loan Comparison –
items.desc: No hidden fees, no misleading rates—just clear, transparent offers aligned with the Fair Practices Code (FPC).

securityInfo.footerPara: Stay informed, compare confidently, and secure your loan with peace of mind.
